prompt: Complete CsvSplitter.parseLine so it splits a CSV line on commas and trims whitespace from every field, keeping empty fields.
explanation: String.split(",") silently drops trailing empty strings, so "a,b," would lose its last field. Passing a negative limit -- split(",", -1) -- keeps every field, empty or not. A simple loop then trims each element in place with String.trim().
hints: String.split takes a second 'limit' argument; a negative limit keeps trailing empty fields.
split(",", -1) returns the raw fields; each may still have spaces around it.
Loop over the array and replace each element with element.trim() before returning it.
